name: TheBbApp: Native Mobile App Template for WordPress
author: thebbapp

sections.description:
The BbApp framework lets you skip months of pain on the repetitive parts of building a very expensive app for WordPress.

It includes an XCode project template and dozens of frameworks to tie them together ready for review by the app store.

You can use BbApp with WordPress alone or BBPress. To enjoy a fully-featured native app just download, build in XCode, and publish.

It also includes open-source PHP libraries that make it easy to integrate your existing native mobile application with WordPress.

Features

  • Instant post loading
  • Guest push alerts for new posts and comments
  • Infinite scroll
  • Guest posts + comments (BBPress only)
  • Guest comments (WordPress and BBPress)
  • Multiple post categories (WordPress only)
  • Offline mode
  • Mark read/unread
  • Dark mode
  • Deep links
  • “Install” website app banner

Getting started

  1. Create an Apple Developer account
  2. Install this plugin for WordPress
  3. Copy the XCode template project

short_description: BbApp is a native mobile application with push alerts, instant loading and offline mode for WordPress. Also works with BBPress.
